name: Dancing
overview: Scripture presents dancing as an expression of joy and celebration, as seen when Miriam led the women in dance after crossing the Red Sea (Exodus 15:20) and Jephthah’s daughter greeted him with timbrels and dances (Judges 11:34). However, dancing can also be associated with idolatry and sin, exemplified by the revelry around the golden calf that provoked Moses’ anger (Exodus 32:6, 19). The context and heart behind dancing are crucial, distinguishing worshipful praise from improper or shameful conduct.
